documents.title: Palm Beach County FY2026 Budget in Brief & Fact Sheet
documents.note: FY2026 adopted all-funds budget $9,606,627,411 (operating appropriation $4,577,145,144). The Budget in Brief and Fact Sheet agree to the dollar. Countywide operating millage 4.5000.

documents.title: Palm Beach County OpenGov Checkbook
documents.note: The Clerk & Comptroller launched an OpenGov transparency portal in 2025 — searchable spending by function, with downloadable data.
